status: Exploratory follow-up after completed source26 and source28; commit tested protocol before new inference.
known_results: Continuous v2: present Dice0.6925238080 vs native0.7190363462. Native-bank single-target regional effect+0.00009663, Holm3p1. Seq13 has the largest continuous-v2 loss. These outcomes motivated this diagnostic; no independent confirmation is claimed.

offline.cohort: All21 promptable sequences/2012 targets, native source23 vs v2 and all3 random seeds source26. Confirm completed delivery, archive CRC/parameter receipts, exact frame/GT-presence agreement, four-layer/count matching and reproduction of published sequence means. Recompute Dice/IoU from every saved binary PNG and current GT, with manifest identity verified; spot-check Boundary F on first/middle/last targets of every sequence.
offline.divergence: First raw-logit hash difference and first decoded binary-mask difference separately. Small numerical/logit changes are not called segmentation failures. First actual pruning is raw spatial keys minus retained spatial keys >0; no metric threshold selects this frame.
offline.degradation: Descriptive longest consecutive run of present targets with strictly negative v2-native Dice difference; absent targets break runs, ties break runs, earliest start resolves equal lengths. Reuse failure_episodes with threshold0/minimum_length1. Report run start/end/length and integrated deficit, not a clinically significant failure designation. No fitted Dice cutoff.
offline.outputs: Per-frame Dice, IoU, Boundary F, object scores, binary disagreement, false alarms, removed token counts; per-sequence and equal-sequence summaries and trajectory plots. GT evaluates outcomes only. All results are descriptive/post hoc.

sequence_choice: Seq13 was selected because its known continuous-v2 loss was largest; seq2 is the original engineering companion, fixed before this new offline analysis. No dataset-wide significance claim from these two selected sequences.
pulse_rule: For each selected sequence, fix t to the first source26 C2 read with any removed spatial keys. Require all prediction/low-res/bank/cache hashes before t to equal source23 native. Freeze explicit t values and source archive hashes in the offline report and commit a target receipt before pilot inference. If no actual pruning exists or a prefix differs, stop; do not substitute an outcome-selected frame.
conditions: one random pulse for each seed20261025/20261026/20261027
implementation: At t only, use existing SparseMemoryRead region_native, unchanged Efficient-SAM2 gather/pruned RoPE and contribution_cells on actual stored native mask logits. Prompt/latest remain dense; native pointer values and temporal slots unchanged. Random masks use existing random_cells(sequence,stored_frame,seed), exactly as source26, with equal per-frame counts. Native writer encodes the pulse prediction normally. Remove all sparse hooks immediately after that single yielded target and continue the untouched author predictor to sequence end, with no later pruning. This intentionally permits a pulse's changed memory write, unlike source28's no-writeback replay.
references: Reuse completed native and continuous-v2/random trajectories. Every prefix before t must match native exactly. At t, regional/random logits, low-res mask, full stored bank and image-cache hashes must match their corresponding continuous source26 arm. No ad-hoc reproduction tolerance. Native sham must match source23 through the entire sequence.
gate: Complete seq2 native-sham rollout; complete seq2 regional pulse and all three random pulses twice with fresh models/states. Every repeat must match frame logits/low-res/bank/cache and pulse selection receipts exactly. At t verify all4 layers, actual counts, native frames/pointers/temporal slots; outside t no sparse-forward override or selector attributes may remain and raw native memory counts/pointers must match archived C0. Verify normal memory writes and frozen parameters. Only after gate and artifact delivery pass, run seq13 regional plus three random pulses. Reuse first seq2 gate runs as pilot outcomes; do not rerun them.
summary: Report whole postprompt and strictly-after-pulse present Dice, IoU and Boundary F, empty-frame false alarms, return episodes, binary/logit divergence and runs of lower Dice. Preserve all three seed results and their within-sequence mean. No inferential p-values for two post-hoc selected sequences. Persistent change after one pulse demonstrates trajectory sensitivity for that intervention; stable pulse but harmful continuous-v2 is consistent with repeated interventions/changed banks, not proof of a unique mechanism. Stopping pruning does not undo the already-altered memory.
decision: Do not tune a replacement heuristic or launch SAMURAI/SAM2Long extensions in this task. Use the diagnostics to decide whether further regional deletion is justified. If no reproducible useful regional effect appears, retain the analysis result and defer a method claim.
execution: CPU FP32/no autocast, original native memory dtype, same pinned SAM2 checkpoint/manifest/prompts. Reuse existing upstream repositories and verified adapters; new orchestration/statistics are project logic. Freeze sources/explicit targets before inference; stop on integrity/resource/delivery failure, never effect sign. Outputs, staged frames, caches, masks, plots and receipts stay on mounted Drive.
